parsed.name: 数字解调模块
parsed.description: 这是一种面向量子测量实验的数字解调仪器，带有ADC通道，用于采集并数字解调读出信号。它可为单边带或双边带读出配置积分权重与旋转矩阵，并支持相关性、误差分数等测量相关设置，常用于超导量子比特读出与状态判别。
parsed.description_en: This is a digital demodulation instrument for quantum measurement experiments, with ADC channels for acquiring and digitally demodulating readout signals. It can be configured with integration weights and rotation matrices for single-sideband or double-sideband readout, and supports measurement-related settings such as correlations and error fractions. It is commonly used for superconducting qubit readout and state discrimination.
